task: Unify `codemie proxy connect` into a single command with orthogonal target flags (--claude-desktop, --vscode, --vscode-claude-code), deprecate the desktop/vscode subcommands as highlighted aliases, and make bare `connect` print a user-friendly target list.

key_reasoning.reason: Restructures the `connect` Commander group and two ~200-line action bodies in src/cli/commands/proxy/index.ts, introduces a new abstraction that orchestrates three config writers (desktop.ts, vscode.ts, vscode-claude-code.ts) over one daemon lifecycle, reconciles two divergent daemon-match strategies (telemetryMode gate vs full inline match), and adds deprecated desktop/vscode aliases plus a bare-connect target list.

Base M (10 well-enumerated acceptance criteria and an explicit out-of-scope list), bumped to L by the TBD clarity red flag: the approved story defers three Open Questions to engineering, notably multi-target telemetryMode/clientType attribution and the standalone daemon posture for --vscode-claude-code, both of which carry rework risk.

Novel composition of several target writes over a single daemon-lifecycle with new per-target success/failure summary and non-zero exit on partial failure (no current analogue), executed with no unit-test safety net on the exact connect action bodies being rewritten and uncovered writers (writeVsCodeClaudeCodeConfig, writeDesktopConfig, spawnDaemon, stopDaemon). A live integration test hard-codes `codemie proxy connect vscode` and clientType 'vscode-byok' that the aliases must preserve. Rollback is cheap (flag unreleased), so not XL.
